basic_info.description: Prime investment opportunity in the heart of the vibrant 24th Street corridor of the Inner Mission. The 3-unit fully occupied building consists of two recently remodeled 1-bedroom residential flats above a commercial ground level - making it an ideal turn-key investment property. The spacious residential units have been remodeled by the current owner and feature tall ceilings, updated kitchens and baths, in-unit laundry, hardwood floors, and sunny decks with Southern exposure. The ground level is leased by the established and highly rated Tacos Del Barrio restaurant - this tenant pays 1/3 of taxes and insurance effectively adding to already impressive general income. Ideally located in the heart of the cultural Inner Mission, the new AI hub, the property is Walker's and Biker's Paradise.
